name: shell-kit
description: Shell poteto bar: PSR Shell encode. ShellCheck, shfmt, quote expansions, set -euo pipefail, safe temps (mktemp+trap), read -r (SC2162), tests for filenames/signals/empty. Tier 0 single-walk rg (eval, unsafe /tmp/$$, unquoted for/cd/rm, curl|sh, bare read) + hotpath budget + ShellCheck + shfmt + strict-set + test presence. Requires ripgrep.
